 "Grand Theft Auto VI" has begun rolling out worldwide, bringing players back to Rockstar Games' Vice City. 
 The hotly anticipated game becomes playable at midnight local time Thursday on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, putting New Zealand among the first countries to get it. 
 "The gameplay dynamics are just amazing and the graphics are great," said Adam Simmons, a director of photography in Wellington who launched the game in his living room as soon as it unlocked. 
 The "Grand Theft Auto" franchise has sold more than 470 million units worldwide. 
 The new game features two protagonists, Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, in a sprawling Florida-inspired world. 
 Miami has embraced its connection to Vice City with local promotions and events.
